sophie_support: Heads up — customer (acct: acme-corp) reports tool call failing intermittently when using TS SDK v1.4.3. Error: 422 invalid_tool_arguments. Payload attached. :eyes:

 dan_dev: Can you paste the raw request body and the SDK version + snippet? Is this Hosted or Dedicated?

 sophie_support: Hosted. Request id: `req_0a1b2c`. Snippet:
```ts
const res = await client.callTool({
  name: 'fetch_user',
  args: JSON.stringify({ id: 123 })
})
```
Response: `400 Tool invocation failed: schema mismatch for arg 'id' expected string got number`

 mike_sre: Ah — they stringify args before passing to SDK which expects an object. TS SDK should detect and avoid double-encoding but maybe a regression. Which channel? support-prod-us-east

 dan_dev: TS SDK v1.4.3 had known change where `callTool` accepts `args: Record<string, any> | string`. If you pass string it will be sent as-is, which backend expects object; but we historically auto-parsed. Did they upgrade from 1.3.x?

 sophie_support: They were on 1.3.9 and pinned to 1.4.3 last week. Repro: I tried locally with 1.4.3 and I can reproduce with a minimal request. Logs:
```
-> POST /v1/tool/call
{"tool":"fetch_user","args":"{\"id\":123}"}
<- 422 {"error":"invalid_schema","detail":"args.id: should be string"}
```

 jenna_ml: Our tool schema for fetch_user expects `id: string` (UUID). The bug is twofold: SDK double-encodes numbers and our server doesn't coerce. But why was it working before? Maybe prior SDK converted numeric id to string when serializing.

 mike_sre: Confirming: this is causing wrong tool routing in some cases because tool selection uses schema match. If args are wrong it falls back to default tool `noop` and triggers errors.

 dan_dev: Assigning to eng-runtime to check TS SDK deserialization path and server schema validation. @mike_sre can you add logs showing the decision path? Also need minimal repro across Py/Go clients.

 mike_sre: :thumbsup: I'll attach logs and reproduce matrix. Quick check — Go SDK had similar change in 0.9.0 where `args` param became `any`. Might be same regression.

 sophie_support: Customer is hitting this in prod; they see ~30% tool failures. They want ETA and workaround. Workaround suggested: downgrade to 1.3.9 or ensure args are passed as typed objects with correct types (stringify id).

 dan_dev: We should provide temporary patch in Hosted to accept stringified JSON for args of object type and coerce numeric->string for fields with string schema, with a rollout guard for enterprise tenants. Will open a rollout plan.

 jenna_ml: Also update SDK docs to warn about passing already-stringified args. Add CI test to catch double-encoding regressions. Adding to sprint.

 ci-bot: ticket created: INF-7892 - 'Tool call arg double-encoding regression' assigned to eng-runtime. Priority: P1. Links: internal/repro/1775123456

 sophie_support: Thanks team. I'll send customer the workaround and ETA once we have patch timeline. cc @dan_dev @mike_sre
